about: Arranging by Project puts each Group, and each column in none, on its Project's workspace, and one of no Project on a free one: the Person's own column in none, with no Pane an Agent opened, first, right of the columns in none at its start, in the order they stood; any other last, a Group led by a Pane of a kind that `leads` (a Thread) as its lead's Project says, still filling the screen; one already there stays, but for the Person's own column in none past the start, which goes to it, and with `only` only that Project's move, and none already there.
